docs.title: 🌀 Kron Documentation
docs.text: Welcome to the official documentation for Kron — the open automation framework for DevOps and SREs.

docs.title: ✨ Overview
docs.text:
Kron is a modular CLI written in Go, built with Cobra. It provides a pluggable structure to add automation commands like:

  • Managing YAML/JSON configurations
  • Automating GitHub/GitLab PRs
  • Spinning up local observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Managing infrastructure from the command line

docs.title: 🧩 Getting Started
docs.text: '''bash git clone https://github.com/kroniar/kron.git cd kron go run main.go '''

docs.title: 🤝 Contributing to Kron Docs
docs.text:
Thanks for helping us improve Kron!

To edit documentation: 1. Update or create Markdown files in the /docs folder. 2. Commit your changes and open a PR. 3. GitHub Pages automatically rebuilds docs after merge.

Docs are served at: 👉 https://kroniar.github.io/kron

docs.title: kron
docs.text: Kron — automate DevOps workflows, configs, and local setups

docs.title: Synopsis
docs.text:
Kron is an open source DevOps automation CLI.

You can use it to: • Modify JSON/YAML files across projects • Automate GitHub/GitLab pull requests • Set up local Grafana/Prometheus instances • Expose and collect metrics easily

Examples: kron yaml update config.yaml --set replicas=3 kron pr create --repo github.com/user/repo --branch feature-x kron setup prometheus grafana

kron [flags]

docs.title: kron completion bash
docs.text: Generate the autocompletion script for bash

docs.title: Synopsis
docs.text:
Generate the autocompletion script for the bash shell.

This script depends on the 'bash-completion' package. If it is not installed already, you can install it via your OS's package manager.

To load completions in your current shell session:

source <(kron completion bash)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

docs.title: Linux:
docs.text: kron completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/kron

docs.title: macOS:
docs.text:
kron completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/kron

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

kron completion bash

docs.title: Options
docs.text:
-h, --help              help for bash
      --no-descriptions   disable completion descriptions

docs.title: kron completion fish
docs.text: Generate the autocompletion script for fish

docs.title: Synopsis

To load completions in your current shell session:

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

kron completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/kron.fish

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

kron completion fish [flags]

docs.title: kron completion zsh
docs.text: Generate the autocompletion script for zsh

docs.title: Synopsis
docs.text:
Generate the autocompletion script for the zsh shell.

If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment you will need to enable it. You can execute the following once:

echo "autoload -U compinit; compinit" >> ~/.zshrc

To load completions in your current shell session:

source <(kron completion zsh)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

docs.title: Linux:
docs.text: kron completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_kron"

docs.title: macOS:
docs.text:
kron completion zsh > $(brew --prefix)/share/zsh/site-functions/_kron

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

kron completion zsh [flags]

docs.title: Options
docs.text:
-h, --help              help for zsh
      --no-descriptions   disable completion descriptions

docs.title: kron setup
docs.text: Install or manage system dependencies (preloaded with popular tools)

docs.title: Synopsis
docs.text:
Kron Setup lets you install essential DevOps tools easily.

Examples: kron setup list kron setup docker kron setup prometheus kron setup docker --force # reinstall or update

kron setup [tool|list] [flags]

docs.title: Options
docs.text:
-f, --force   Force reinstall even if already installed
  -h, --help    help for setup
